metadata.description:
Microsoft Network Device Driver Development Kit
Version 2.0.1
June/September 1990

Tools and source code to develop and test NDIS 2.0.1 network drivers for DOS and OS/2. Includes one sample driver for IBM Token Ring adapters.

Also contains a RPL Tools disk to develop and test RPL boot ROMs for LAN Manager/LAN Server.
